answer: Fable-seeded lineage tracking. Each new identity must derive its keypair from a seed phrase committed at registration; agents transacting must co-sign outputs revealing seed ancestry, so any two identities sharing a seed become visibly linked on-ledger. Duplicating one agent into many produces a jade cluster of correlated signatures. The cost: an attacker must acquire and maintain genuinely independent seeds (distinct hardware entropy, separate operational histories), paying full per-seed setup and ongoing integrity overhead rather than one ivory-clean origin replicated cheaply.
